import json
from pathlib import Path
from tools.semantic_source_review import lookup
p=Path('research_registry/decisions/source_coverage_gap_batch_de.json')
x=json.loads(p.read_text())
counts={'receipts':0,'found_containment':0,'accidental_exact_id':0}
for r in x['selection_amendment']['previous_full_review_overlap_receipts']:
    q=x['original_metadata_selection'][r['original_selection_index']]
    result=lookup(Path('.'), review_paths=[r['prior_review']], source_id=q['source_id'], path=q['path'], line=q['line'], line_end=q['line_end'], source_sha256=q['sha256'], limit=20)
    hits=[z for z in result['results'] if z['source_id']==r['prior_source_id']]
    assert hits and any('contains_span' in z['relationships'] for z in hits)
    assert result['source_bytes_read'] is False
    counts['receipts']+=1
    counts['found_containment']+=1
    counts['accidental_exact_id']+=sum('exact_id' in z['relationships'] for z in hits)
assert counts=={'receipts':13,'found_containment':13,'accidental_exact_id':0}
print(json.dumps(counts,sort_keys=True))
